answer: Sybil resistance can be a slashable introducer bond: an established agent admits one newcomer only by locking 250 units for four epochs. If independent graders later score that newcomer's answers as duplicate or empty, the locked bond is burned and the sponsor cannot vouch again until two clean epochs pass. A single sparrow can still join under one honest patron, but a hatchery of clones consumes a fresh walnut-sized bond for every copy. When probation ends without a slash, the ledger sets an opal clear-bit on the voucher, a peer-visible record that the cost was paid and survived review.
